# MoodCut Script reference

<!-- Generated by `moodcut docs`; do not edit by hand. -->

This is exactly what AI assistants get from the MCP `help` tool, generated from the same schema the engine validates against.

```text
MoodCut: AI-native video editor. Loop: media import -> view -> edit (batch many lines) -> preview (contact sheet) -> render.
Ids: m1 media, c2 clips, t3 text, g4 shapes, o5 solids, j6 adjustment, n7 nested comps, s1 comps; sub-objects c2.f1 (effect) c2.m1 (mask) g4.s1 (shape) t3.x1 (text animator).
Tracks: V1 is the bottom video track (higher = on top), A1.. audio. Times are seconds.
Scripts are atomic: if any line fails nothing changes and the error names the line.
Topics: workflow (a complete edit from one request, step by step), edit (every MoodCut Script command), time (time & reference syntax), props (layer/clip/text/solid properties), effects (video effects + params), audio (audio effects, ducking, loudness), transitions (transition types), anim (animation presets, easing, keyframes), text (titles, text animators, captions), shapes (shape layers & masks), templates (motion graphics templates), macros (autocut, captions, montage, reframe...), color (color grading), expr (expressions), render (export presets), analyze (analysis kinds), graphics (HTML/CSS/JS motion graphics), examples (complete example scripts), fonts (installed fonts)
```

## workflow: a complete edit from one request, step by step

```text
Turning one request into a finished, professional edit. Do every step yourself; send many script lines per edit call; ask the person only if something essential is missing.
1 GATHER  media find path=<folder> (what is there) -> media import paths=[<folder>] tag=<shoot>. Large library: media list (filters/paging) + preview media=m1..m48 (poster frames, 48 per sheet). Write down what you see so you never look twice: note m3 'wide drone, sunset' | tag m10..m18 interview.
2 UNDERSTAND  speech: analyze target=tag:interview kind=transcript, then view what=search q=<words> to find quotes (times are source seconds). Shots: analyze target=all kind=scenes / stats (exposure). Music: analyze <m> kind=beats. Filmstrips (preview media=m7 n=8) to pick in/out points.
3 PLAN  length, format (comp new 'Main' 1080x1920 30 or reframe 9:16 later), structure (hook in the first 3 s -> body -> payoff / call to action), music, look, graphics. Build only what was asked.
4 ASSEMBLE  story on V1: append m4[12.3-18.9] m4[41-47.5] ... (quotes from transcripts) or add + autocut silence for talking heads; keep m4 12-30,45-61 for rough cuts; b-roll on V2 over speech (add m7[2-5] V2 at=c3.start+1); montage m1,m2,... music=m9 beats=2 for beat-cut sequences. Typical shots 1.5-4 s; vary framing; cut on action; no repeated shots. Portrait footage in a landscape edit (or the reverse): set <ids> fit=blur.
5 POLISH  color <ids|V1> natural|cinematic then fine-tune; tr V1 dissolve 0.3 only where it helps; titles and lower thirds: the graphic tool (HTML/CSS, best looking) or title templates; captions <clip> for speech-led videos; anim kenburns on stills.
6 SOUND  music on A2 under speech: duck A2 by=A1 amount=-12 (by=V1 when speech is camera audio); fade music in/out; master lufs=-14 limiter=1 (web) | -16 (podcast) | -23 (broadcast).
7 VERIFY  check expect={dur, size, captions, music} (fix=true applies the safe fixes) and look at its problem frames; preview n=8 for the overall flow; fix what remains and check again until clean.
8 DELIVER  render preset=youtube | social | prores ... (wait=true); captions as a file: render preset=srt; YouTube chapters from markers: render preset=chapters; to finish in Premiere/Resolve: render preset=xml; vertical version: reframe 9:16 main, check, render preset=social. Report what you made: length, structure, music, files.
```

## edit: every MoodCut Script command

```text
MoodCut Script — `verb args key=value`, one per line (or `;`). Quote text with '...'. Flags are bare words (ripple).
PLACE
 add <media|path|comp>[in-out] [V2|A1] [at=T|after=id] [in=] [out=] [dur=] [speed=2] [as=name] [mode=overwrite|insert] [props..]
   no at= -> appends to end of V1/A1. at= -> lowest free track. mode=insert ripples.
 append m1[0-5] m2[10-15] m3     sequential clips (magnetic)
 insert m4 at=10                 ripple insert
 text 'Title' [at=0 dur=3] [size= color= font= weight=] [style=title|caption|box|neon|outline|gradient] [enter=fadeUp exit=fadeDown]
 shape <rect|ellipse|circle|polygon|star|path|line|arrow> [w= h= fill= stroke= strokeW= radius=] [pos=..] [at dur]
 shape add <shapeLayer> ellipse ...  (more shapes in one layer)
 solid <color> [at dur] [w h radius color2 gradAngle]   adjust [at dur] [fx=blur,vignette]   (adjustment layer)
 import <path..> [as=name] [tag=a,b]   comp new 'Name' 1080x1920 30 | comp use s2 | comp main s2 | comp set s1 bg=#111 dur=20
 track add V|A [n] | track set V2 hidden=1 locked=1 mute=1 solo=1 vol=-3 | track del V3 [force]
LIBRARY (media: m3, m1..m40, all, tag:x, kind:video|audio|image|graphic, q:words)
 tag <media> broll,drone | untag <media> [tag] | note <media> 'what is in the shot' | relink m3 <new path> | unimport <media> [force]
EDIT
 cut <id|V1|all> at=T[,T2]       trim <id> start=T|+d end=T|-d dur= in= [ripple]
 del <ids> [ripple|ripple=all]   move <ids> at=T|by=+2 [track=V2] [mode=overwrite]
 slip <id> +0.5   slide <id> -0.3   speed <ids> 2x|50% [ripple] [interp=blend|flow]   reverse <id>   fit <id> dur=5
 freeze <id> at=T dur=2   dup <id> [at= track=]   replace <id> <media>   detach <id> (split audio)   close V1 (remove gaps)   gap V1 at= dur=
 name <id> <name>   marker add T 'drop'   marker del T   precomp <ids> name='Group'
PROPERTIES & MOTION
 set <ids|id.f1|V1> key=value ...   (set clears keyframes on that prop)
 kf <id|id.f1> <prop> t:v[@ease] ... [ease=out] [loop=cycle|pingpong]   kf+ adds/merges   kf- <id> <prop> [t] removes
   keyframe times are item-relative: 0, 1.5, end, end-0.5, 50%. Values like props (pos=x,y scale=1.2 or 1.2,0.8)
 expr <id> <prop> 'wiggle(2,30)'   (- clears)      anim <ids> popIn,fadeOut [dur= delay= ease= amount= freq= at=T]
 parent <ids> <parent|none>   matte <id> <srcLayer> [alpha|alphainv|luma|lumainv]
LOOK
 fx <ids> <effect> [params]   fx <id.f1> param=v | del | on | off | up | down   fx <id> clear
 afx <id|A1|master> <audioEffect> [params]
 color <ids> <preset> | color <ids> exposure=.3 contrast=15 temp=-10 sat=110   lut <ids> file.cube [amount]
 mask <id> <rect|ellipse|path|polygon|star> [x y w h feather expand invert mode]   mask <id.m1> feather=60 | del
 tr <a> <b> <kind> [dur]   tr <id> in|out <kind> [dur]   tr V1 dissolve 0.4 (all cuts)   tr <a> <b> none
 fade <ids> [in=0.5] [out=1] [video|audio]
AUDIO
 set <id> vol=-6dB pan=-0.3 mute=1 fadeIn=1 fadeOut=2   duck A1 by=A2 amount=-12   master vol=-1 lufs=-14 limiter=1
MACROS (see help macros)
 autocut silence|scenes <clip>   captions <clip> [style=]   montage m1,m2 music=<m|clip> [beats=2]   beats <music>
 reframe 9:16 [mode=blur|fill|fit]   keep <media> 0-12.5,15-30   title <template> [params]
REFERENCES  $ last created, $2 second created in this script; names given with as= work anywhere an id does.
```

## time: time & reference syntax

```text
Times: 12 | 12.5s | 500ms | 90f (frames) | 1:02.5 (m:s) | 1:02:03.5 | 00:00:12:15 (timecode with frames)
 end (comp end) | c3.start c3.end c3.mid | @drop (marker) | sums: c3.end+0.5, end-2. Relative edits: +0.5 / -1.
Keyframe times are relative to the item start; end = item duration; 50% = half of the item.
Positions: pos=960,540 | pos=center | top | bottom | left | right | top-left ... | lower-third | pos=50%,80%.
Units: opacity=50% scale=120% vol=-6dB rot=45 (degrees). Colors: #fff #ff0055 #00000080 rgb(255,0,0) red none.
```

## props: layer/clip/text/solid properties

```text
Static props (static) can't be keyframed. Use with add/set/kf.
Every layer:
 pos=center [x,y] Position in comp pixels (accepts center, top, bottom-left, 50%,80% ...)
 scale=1,1 [x,y] Scale factor (1 = 100%, accepts 120% or 1.2 or 1.2,0.8)
 rot=0 [num] Rotation in degrees (clockwise)
 opacity=1 [num 0..1] Opacity 0-1 (accepts 50%)
 anchor=0.5,0.5 [x,y] Anchor point as fraction of layer bounds (0.5,0.5 = center)
 rx=0 [num] 3D rotation around X axis (degrees, perspective)
 ry=0 [num] 3D rotation around Y axis (degrees, perspective)
 z=0 [num] 3D depth (positive = farther, perspective)
 skew=0 [num -85..85] Horizontal skew in degrees
 blend=normal [normal|multiply|screen|overlay|darken|lighten|colordodge|colorburn|hardlight|softlight|difference|exclusion|hue|saturation|color|luminosity|add] (static) Blend mode
 mblur=false [bool] (static) Motion blur for animated transforms
Media clip:
 speed=1 [num] (static) Playback speed (2 = 2x faster, 50% = half). Changes duration via the speed command
 reverse=false [bool] (static) Play backwards
 fit=fit [fit|fill|blur|stretch|none] (static) How media is fitted into the comp (blur: fitted over a blurred fill of itself)
 hold=false [bool] (static) Freeze frame (shows the in-point frame)
 remap=-1 [num] Time remap: keyframes map item time -> source seconds (-1 = off)
 interp=none [none|blend|flow] (static) Slow-motion frame interpolation
 vol=0 [num -96..24] Audio gain in dB (accepts -6dB)
 pan=0 [num] (static) Stereo pan -1 (left) .. 1 (right)
 mute=false [bool] (static) Mute the clip's audio
 fadeIn=0 [num] (static) Audio fade-in seconds
 fadeOut=0 [num] (static) Audio fade-out seconds
Text:
 font=Inter [text] (static) Font family (system fonts; Inter is bundled)
 weight=700 [num] (static) Font weight 100-900 or thin/light/regular/medium/semibold/bold/black
 italic=false [bool] (static) Italic style
 size=96 [num 1..2000] Font size in px
 color=#ffffff [color] Text fill color
 color2=none [color] Second fill color for a vertical gradient (none = solid)
 stroke=none [color] Outline color
 strokeW=0 [num 0..200] Outline width
 align=center [center|left|right] (static) Horizontal alignment
 lineH=1.15 [num 0.5..4] Line height multiplier
 tracking=0 [num -200..2000] Letter spacing in px
 boxW=0 [num] (static) Wrap width in px (0 = no wrapping)
 caps=false [bool] (static) Render in UPPERCASE
 bg=none [color] Background box color (caption style)
 bgPad=18 [num 0..500] Background box padding
 bgRadius=14 [num 0..500] Background box corner radius
 bgMode=line [block|line] (static) One box for the block or one per line
 shadow=none [color] Drop shadow color (e.g. #000000aa)
 shadowX=0 [num -500..500] Shadow X offset
 shadowY=6 [num -500..500] Shadow Y offset
 shadowBlur=14 [num 0..200] Shadow blur radius
 reveal=1 [num 0..1] Fraction of characters visible (typewriter style; animate 0->1)
Solid:
 color=#ffffff [color] Fill color
 color2=none [color] Gradient end color (none = solid)
 gradType=linear [linear|radial] (static) Gradient type
 gradAngle=90 [num] Linear gradient angle (90 = top to bottom)
 w=compW [num 0..100000] Width (default comp width)
 h=compH [num 0..100000] Height (default comp height)
 radius=0 [num 0..100000] Corner radius
Nested comp:
 speed=1 [num] (static) Playback speed of the nested comp
 fit=none [none|fit|fill|stretch] (static) How the nested comp is fitted
 remap=-1 [num] Time remap keyframes -> nested comp seconds (-1 = off)
 vol=0 [num -96..24] Audio gain of the nested comp in dB
 mute=false [bool] (static) Mute nested audio
```

## effects: video effects + params

```text
fx <id> <effect> [param=value...]  (params are animatable via kf <id>.fN <param> ...). Spatial params in comp px.
[color]
 lumetri (aka grade color colorgrade): Premiere-style basic correction. exposure=0 contrast=0 highlights=0 shadows=0 whites=0 blacks=0 temp=0 tint=0 sat=100 vibrance=0 fade=0 stint=none htint=none
 bc (aka brightness contrast brightnesscontrast): Brightness & contrast. brightness=0 contrast=0
 exposure: Exposure, offset and gamma. stops=0 offset=0 gamma=1
 levels: Input/output levels. inBlack=0 inWhite=1 gamma=1 outBlack=0 outWhite=1
 curves: Tone curves from control points 'x,y x,y ...' (0..1). master='' r='' g='' b=''
 hue (aka huesat hsl): Hue / saturation / lightness. shift=0 sat=1 light=0
 saturation (aka sat): Saturation. amount=1
 vibrance: Vibrance (protects saturated colors). amount=0.5
 temperature (aka wb whitebalance): White balance shift. temp=0 tint=0
 tint: Map blacks/whites to colors. black=#000000 white=#ffffff amount=1
 duotone: Two-color gradient map. dark=#1b1464 light=#ff5f6d amount=1
 fill (aka colorize colorfill): Fill the layer with a color (keeps alpha). color=#ffffff amount=1
 grayscale (aka bw blackwhite mono desaturate): Black & white. amount=1
 sepia: Sepia tone. amount=1
 invert (aka negative): Invert colors. amount=1
 lut (aka lut3d cube): Apply a .cube 3D LUT. file='' amount=1
 posterize: Reduce color levels. levels=6
 threshold: Black/white threshold. level=0.5
[blur]
 blur (aka gaussian gaussianblur): Gaussian blur. radius=10 dir=both
 dirblur (aka motionblurfx directionalblur): Directional (motion) blur. angle=0 length=30
 zoomblur (aka radialblur): Radial zoom blur. amount=0.15 cx=0.5 cy=0.5
 sharpen (aka unsharp): Unsharp mask sharpening. amount=1 radius=1.5
[stylize]
 glow (aka bloom): Glow / bloom. radius=24 intensity=1 threshold=0.6 color=none
 shadow (aka dropshadow): Drop shadow. color=#000000 opacity=0.6 angle=135 distance=12 blur=16
 stroke (aka outline border): Outline around the layer's alpha. color=#ffffff width=6
 vignette: Darken the frame edges. amount=0.5 size=0.6 soft=0.5 color=#000000
 noise (aka grain filmgrain): Film grain / noise. amount=0.12 mono=true animated=true
 pixelate (aka mosaic): Pixelate. size=16
 rgbsplit (aka chromatic chromaticaberration rgbshift): RGB channel split. amount=6 angle=0
 glitch (aka datamosh): Digital glitch (slice displacement + RGB split). amount=0.5 slices=14 speed=12
 scanlines (aka crt): CRT scanlines. spacing=4 opacity=0.3
 letterbox (aka cinemabars bars): Cinematic bars. ratio=2.39 color=#000000
[generate]
 gradient (aka ramp gradientramp): Gradient overlay (blends over layer content). c1=#000000 c2=#ffffff type=linear angle=90 amount=1
 lightleak (aka leak): Animated warm light leaks (screen blend). color=#ff7a18 amount=0.6 speed=0.25
[distort]
 wave (aka wavewarp): Wave warp. amp=12 length=120 speed=1 dir=h
 twirl (aka swirl): Twirl around a center. angle=90 radius=0.4 cx=0.5 cy=0.5
 bulge (aka pinch fisheye): Bulge (+) / pinch (-). amount=0.5 radius=0.4 cx=0.5 cy=0.5
 mirror: Mirror half of the frame. axis=h
 kaleido (aka kaleidoscope): Kaleidoscope. segments=6 angle=0
 flip: Flip horizontally / vertically. h=true v=false
 crop: Crop layer edges (fractions of the layer). l=0 t=0 r=0 b=0 soft=0
 cornerpin (aka pin perspective): Pin the layer corners to comp points (screen replacement). tl=0,0 tr=1920,0 br=1920,1080 bl=0,1080
[keying]
 chromakey (aka greenscreen keylight key): Remove a key color (green screen). color=#00ff00 similarity=0.35 smooth=0.12 spill=0.6
 lumakey: Key out dark (or bright) areas. threshold=0.1 smooth=0.1 invert=false
[ffmpeg] decode-time, video clips only, static params
 denoise (aka hqdn3d): Video denoise (FFmpeg hqdn3d). strength=4
 stabilize (aka deshake warpstabilizer): Stabilize shaky footage (FFmpeg deshake). strength=16
 deinterlace (aka bwdif yadif): Deinterlace (FFmpeg bwdif). 
 deflicker: Remove brightness flicker. size=5
 ff (aka ffmpeg vf): Raw FFmpeg video filter chain (escape hatch). filter=''
```

## audio: audio effects, ducking, loudness

```text
afx <clip|A1|master> <effect> [params]. Clip props: vol(dB, keyframable) pan mute fadeIn fadeOut. Track: track set A1 vol=-3 pan=.2 mute=1 solo=1.
Ducking: duck A2 by=A1 amount=-12 attack=20 release=400. Master: master vol=-1 lufs=-14 limiter=1.
 eq: 3-band EQ. bass=0 mid=0 treble=0
 highpass: High-pass filter. freq=80
 lowpass: Low-pass filter. freq=12000
 compress: Dynamic range compressor. threshold=-18 ratio=4 attack=20 release=250 makeup=0
 limiter: Peak limiter. limit=-1
 gate: Noise gate. threshold=-45
 denoise: FFT noise reduction. amount=12
 normalize: EBU R128 loudness normalization. lufs=-14 tp=-1
 reverb: Simple reverb. amount=0.3 size=0.5
 echo: Echo. delay=300 decay=0.4
 pitch: Pitch shift (keeps tempo). semitones=0
 deess: De-esser. amount=0.5
 voice: Voice enhancement chain (HPF + denoise + compress + presence). amount=1
 telephone: Telephone / radio band-pass. 
 ff: Raw FFmpeg audio filter chain. filter=''
```

## transitions: transition types

```text
tr <a> <b> <kind> [dur] [params] (adjacent clips, centered on the cut; uses source handles) | tr <id> in|out <kind> [dur] (from/to transparent) | tr V1 <kind> [dur] (every cut on a track). Default dur 0.5. Any kind accepts ease=. xfade names work too (wipeleft, slideup, circleopen, fadeblack, smoothleft...).
 dissolve: Cross dissolve
 dip: Dip through a color. color=#000000
 fadeblack: Dip to black
 fadewhite: Dip to white
 wipe: Linear wipe. dir=left soft=0.08
 slide: Incoming clip slides in over outgoing. dir=left
 push: Incoming clip pushes outgoing out. dir=left
 reveal: Outgoing clip slides away revealing incoming. dir=left
 zoom: Zoom through with blur. amount=1.5
 zoomout: Outgoing shrinks away revealing incoming
 iris: Circle reveal. soft=0.05
 irisclose: Circle closes onto incoming. soft=0.05
 diamond: Diamond reveal. soft=0.05
 clock: Clock wipe. soft=0.02
 barn: Barn doors open from the center. dir=h soft=0.04
 blinds: Venetian blinds. count=10 dir=v
 blur: Blur out / blur in. amount=40
 whip: Fast whip pan with motion blur. dir=left
 spin: Spin & scale through. turns=0.5
 flash: Bright flash at the cut. color=#ffffff
 glitch: Glitchy RGB/slice transition
 pixelate: Pixelate out and in. size=60
 luma: Luminance-based wipe. soft=0.1 invert=false
 flip: 3D card flip. dir=h
```

## anim: animation presets, easing, keyframes

```text
Easing (kf @ease, anim ease=, animator ease=): linear hold ease(easy ease) in out inout easeIn easeOut easeInOut snap overshoot anticipate,
 in/out/inOut + Quad Cubic Quart Quint Sine Expo Circ Back Elastic Bounce (e.g. outBack, inOutSine), bezier(x1,y1,x2,y2).
Default keyframe ease is `ease` (smooth); add @linear for constant speed.
anim presets write keyframes/expressions on any layer (combine with commas):
[enter] fadeIn (fade from transparent), popIn (scale from 0 with overshoot), zoomIn (scale down from 160% + fade), growIn (scale up from 60% + fade), slideInLeft|Right|Up|Down (slide in from that side (dist=220) + fade), flyInLeft|Right|Up|Down (fly in from off-screen), riseIn (rise 60px + fade), dropIn (drop from above with bounce), spinIn (spin + scale from 0), flipIn (3D flip around Y), swingIn (3D swing around X), blurIn (un-blur + fade), stretchIn (stretch horizontally from 0)
[exit] fadeOut (fade to transparent), popOut (scale to 0 (anticipation)), zoomOut (scale up to 160% + fade), shrinkOut (scale to 60% + fade), slideOutLeft|Right|Up|Down (slide toward that side + fade), flyOutLeft|Right|Up|Down (fly off-screen), sinkOut (sink 60px + fade), spinOut (spin + scale to 0), flipOut (3D flip out), blurOut (blur + fade)
[loop] pulse (gentle scale pulse (amount=0.05 freq=1)), heartbeat (double-beat scale), float (bob up/down (amount=12 freq=0.5)), bounce (bouncing (amount=40 freq=1.5)), spin (continuous rotation (freq = turns/sec)), swing (pendulum rotation (amount=8 deg)), shake (continuous jitter (amount=10 freq=12)), wiggle (smooth random drift (amount=20 freq=1.5)), breathe (opacity breathing), flicker (random flicker)
[one-shot] kenburns (slow zoom 100->112% + drift over the whole item), punch (quick scale punch at=T (beat hits)), shakeHit (camera-shake burst at=T), zoomPunchIn (fast zoom-in that holds (talking-head emphasis) at=T)
[text, per character] typewriter (characters appear one by one), fadeUp (chars fade in rising 40px), pop (chars pop in with overshoot), slideUp (lines slide up + fade), blurIn (chars un-blur + fade), wordPop (words pop in one by one), bounceIn (chars drop in with bounce), dropIn (chars drop from above), spinIn (chars spin in), trackIn (letter spacing collapses + fade (cinematic)), fadeChars (chars fade in (no motion)), wave (continuous wave (loop)), jitter (continuous random jitter (loop)), fadeDown (exit: chars fade out sinking), popOut (exit: chars shrink away), blurOut (exit: chars blur out), typeOut (exit: chars disappear in reverse), slideDown (exit: lines slide down + fade)
Options: dur= delay= ease= amount= freq= dist= at=T (one-shots, timeline time). Exit presets end at the item end.
Keyframes: kf c1 pos 0:-200,540@outExpo 0.6:960,540 | kf c1.f1 radius 0:30 0.5:0 | kf t3 opacity 0:0 0.3:1 end-0.3:1 end:0
```

## text: titles, text animators, captions

```text
text '<content>' at dur [props]. \n = new line. boxW=900 wraps. caps=1. {expr} placeholders are live: '{round(linear(time,0,2,0,1000))} users'.
Styles: style=title|subtitle|caption|box|neon|minimal|outline|gradient|shadow|lowerthird.
Per-character animators: enter=<preset> exit=<preset> or `anim <text> <preset>`; tune with set <text>.x1 stagger=0.05 dur=0.6 ease=outBack unit=word order=random.
Animator kinds: in (from props -> normal), out (normal -> props), loop (wave: x/y/rot amplitude, freq, phase), hl (highlight units at times= list, karaoke).
Animator props: unit char|word|line, order forward|reverse|center|edges|random, stagger, dur, delay, ease, times, opacity x y scale rot blur tracking color freq phase.
Captions: `captions <clip> style=bold|box|minimal|neon words=3 hl=#ffd60a` (needs analyze transcript).
Text props:
 font=Inter [text] (static) Font family (system fonts; Inter is bundled)
 weight=700 [num] (static) Font weight 100-900 or thin/light/regular/medium/semibold/bold/black
 italic=false [bool] (static) Italic style
 size=96 [num 1..2000] Font size in px
 color=#ffffff [color] Text fill color
 color2=none [color] Second fill color for a vertical gradient (none = solid)
 stroke=none [color] Outline color
 strokeW=0 [num 0..200] Outline width
 align=center [center|left|right] (static) Horizontal alignment
 lineH=1.15 [num 0.5..4] Line height multiplier
 tracking=0 [num -200..2000] Letter spacing in px
 boxW=0 [num] (static) Wrap width in px (0 = no wrapping)
 caps=false [bool] (static) Render in UPPERCASE
 bg=none [color] Background box color (caption style)
 bgPad=18 [num 0..500] Background box padding
 bgRadius=14 [num 0..500] Background box corner radius
 bgMode=line [block|line] (static) One box for the block or one per line
 shadow=none [color] Drop shadow color (e.g. #000000aa)
 shadowX=0 [num -500..500] Shadow X offset
 shadowY=6 [num -500..500] Shadow Y offset
 shadowBlur=14 [num 0..200] Shadow blur radius
 reveal=1 [num 0..1] Fraction of characters visible (typewriter style; animate 0->1)
Animator props:
 unit=char [char|word|line] (static) Animate per character, word or line
 order=forward [forward|reverse|center|edges|random] (static) Stagger order
 stagger=0.04 [num] (static) Delay between units (s)
 dur=0.5 [num] (static) Per-unit animation duration (s)
 delay=0 [num] (static) Start delay relative to item start (in) or end (out)
 ease=outCubic [text] (static) Easing (see help anim)
 times='' [text] (static) Explicit unit start times 't0,t1,..' (karaoke); overrides stagger
 opacity=1 [num] (static) Opacity of units at the animated extreme
 x=0 [num] (static) X offset (px)
 y=0 [num] (static) Y offset (px)
 scale=1 [num] (static) Scale
 rot=0 [num] (static) Rotation (deg)
 blur=0 [num] (static) Blur (px)
 tracking=0 [num] (static) Extra spacing (px)
 color=none [color] (static) Color override (none = unchanged)
 freq=1 [num] (static) Loop frequency (Hz) for kind=loop
 phase=30 [num] (static) Loop phase offset per unit (deg) for kind=loop
```

## shapes: shape layers & masks

```text
Shapes: shape <kind> [props] creates a shape layer; shape add <layer> <kind> adds more. Kinds & params:
 rect: w=400 h=200 radius=0
 ellipse: w=200 h=200
 polygon: points=6 radius=120
 star: points=5 r1=120 r2=55
 path: d=M-100,0
 line: from=-200,0 to=200,0
 arrow: from=-200,0 to=200,0 head=40
Common shape props (trim paths = draw-on, repeater = copies):
 offset=0,0 [x,y] Offset of the shape inside its layer (px)
 fill=#ffffff [color] Fill color (none = no fill)
 fill2=none [color] Gradient end color (none = solid fill)
 gradType=linear [linear|radial] (static) Gradient type
 gradAngle=90 [num] Linear gradient angle
 stroke=none [color] Stroke color
 strokeW=0 [num 0..1000] Stroke width
 dash='' [text] (static) Dash pattern e.g. '20,10'
 cap=round [round|butt|square] (static) Stroke line cap
 join=round [round|miter|bevel] (static) Stroke line join
 trimStart=0 [num 0..100] Trim paths start % (stroke draw-on)
 trimEnd=100 [num 0..100] Trim paths end % (animate 0->100 to draw on)
 trimOffset=0 [num] Trim paths offset %
 rot=0 [num] Shape rotation
 scale=1,1 [x,y] Shape scale
 opacity=1 [num 0..1] Shape opacity
 repeat=0 [num 0..500] Repeater: number of extra copies
 repOffset=0,0 [x,y] Repeater offset per copy
 repRot=0 [num] Repeater rotation per copy
 repScale=1,1 [x,y] Repeater scale per copy
 repOpacity=1 [num 0..1] Opacity of the last copy (fades across copies)
Draw-on line: shape path d='M0,0 C200,-150 400,150 600,0' stroke=#fff strokeW=6 fill=none; kf $.s1 trimEnd 0:0 1:100
Masks (x,y,w,h are fractions of the layer; mask <id> <kind> ...):
 x=0.5 [num] Mask center X as fraction of layer width
 y=0.5 [num] Mask center Y as fraction of layer height
 w=0.8 [num] Mask width as fraction of layer width
 h=0.8 [num] Mask height as fraction of layer height
 radius=0 [num] Corner radius (rect masks)
 d='' [text] (static) Path mask: SVG path in normalized 0..1 layer coordinates
 points=5 [num 2..100] Polygon/star points
 feather=0 [num 0..1000] Edge feather (px)
 expand=0 [num -1000..1000] Grow/shrink the mask (px)
 opacity=1 [num 0..1] Mask opacity
 rot=0 [num] Mask rotation
 invert=false [bool] (static) Invert the mask
 mode=add [add|subtract|intersect|difference] (static) How masks combine
Track matte: matte <layer> <matteLayer> alpha|alphainv|luma|lumainv (the matte layer is hidden automatically).
```

## templates: motion graphics templates

```text
title <template> [at=T] [dur=] [params] — builds an editable precomp (inner layer ids are listed in the result).
 lowerthird: name + title lower third. text= sub= color= style=bar|box|minimal|gradient side=left|right font=
 title: big animated title card. text= sub= style=fade|kinetic|typewriter|cinematic|glitch|pop|neon color= font=
 callout: dot + line pointing at a spot, with label. text= x= y= color=
 subscribe: animated subscribe button. text= color=
 counter: number counting up. from= to= prefix= suffix= decimals= color= size=
 progress: progress bar filling over the duration. color= height= pos=top|bottom
 quote: quote card. text= author= color=
 social: social handle pill. text=@handle color=
 chapter: chapter / section heading. num= text= color=
 bars: animated bar chart. values=40,75,60 labels=A,B,C color= suffix=
 shapewipe: colored shape sweep (use over a cut). color= color2= dir=left|right
 lightleak: light leak overlay. color= amount=
 letterbox: cinematic bars overlay. ratio=2.39
 vignette: vignette overlay. amount=
 grain: film grain overlay. amount=
```

## macros: autocut, captions, montage, reframe...

```text
autocut silence <clip> [thresh=-35 min=0.4 pad=0.12 sync]  remove pauses (jump cuts), ripples the track (sync = all tracks)
autocut scenes <clip> [thresh=0.3]      split a clip at scene changes
captions <clip> [style=bold|box|minimal|neon] [words=3] [pos=] [size=] [hl=#ffd60a] [enter=pop] [lang=] [src=file.srt]  animated word-highlight captions
montage m1,m2,m3 music=<media|clip> [beats=2] [at=0] [dur=] [track=V1] [kenburns] [tr=dissolve]  beat-synced cut
beats <music clip|media> [every=1]      markers b1,b2... on beats (use at=@b8)
reframe 9:16|1:1|4:5|WxH [mode=blur|fill|fit] [x=offset] [main]  new comp nesting the current one (blurred background fill)
keep <media> 0-12.5,15-30,41-55        rough cut from source ranges (transcript-driven editing)
precomp <ids> name='Group'              nest items into a new comp
duck <musicTrack> by=<voiceTrack> amount=-12   sidechain ducking
title <template> ...                    motion graphics (help templates)
```

## color: color grading

```text
color <ids> <preset> [then fine-tune] e.g. `color c1 cinematic` then `color c1 exposure=0.2 sat=105`.
lumetri params: exposure(stops) contrast highlights shadows whites blacks temp tint (-100..100) sat(%) vibrance fade stint htint (split-tone colors, alpha=strength).
Other color fx: lut (file.cube), curves (master='0,0 .25,.2 .75,.85 1,1'), levels, hue, saturation, vibrance, temperature, tint, duotone, bc, exposure, grayscale, sepia, invert, posterize.
Use analyze stats to check exposure first. Presets:
cinematic (contrasty teal shadows / warm highlights), tealorange (strong teal & orange blockbuster look), vintage (faded warm film with grain), film (subtle film emulation), bw (black & white), noir (high-contrast B&W with vignette), warm (warmer white balance), cool (cooler white balance), punchy (contrast + vibrance), faded (matte, low contrast), moody (dark, desaturated, cool), airy (bright & soft), sunset (golden warm), cyberpunk (magenta/cyan neon), natural (neutral clean correction)
```

## expr: expressions

```text
Expressions (expr <id> <prop> '...') run every frame on top of keyframes.
Vars: time value dur fps frame index w h cw ch pi. value is the keyed value (number or [x,y]).
Ops: + - * / % ^ < > <= >= == != && || ?: ; vectors [a,b] with elementwise math, value[0].
Funcs: sin cos tan asin acos atan atan2 sqrt abs floor ceil round(x,n) min max clamp pow exp log mod lerp step smoothstep
 linear(t,t0,t1,v0,v1) ease(...) easeIn easeOut random([max]|[min,max]) noise(x) wiggle(freq,amp[,oct,mult,t]) pt(fps) len norm vec deg rad bounce(freq,amp).
Examples: rot 'time*90' | pos 'wiggle(3,20)' | scale 'value*(1+0.05*sin(time*6))' | opacity 'linear(time,0,1,0,1)'.
```

## render: export presets

```text
render tool: preset=<name> [out=path] [range=a-b] [scale=0.5] [hw=auto|nvenc|qsv|amf] [wait=true]. Output defaults to <Videos>/MoodCut Renders. Resolution = comp size × scale.
 mp4: H.264 MP4, high quality (default)
 youtube: H.264 MP4 tuned for YouTube upload
 social: H.264 MP4 for TikTok/Reels/Shorts (aliases: tiktok reels shorts instagram)
 draft: fast low-quality H.264 preview
 hevc: H.265/HEVC MP4 (smaller files)
 av1: AV1 MP4 (SVT-AV1)
 prores: ProRes 422 HQ .mov (editing master)
 prores4444: ProRes 4444 .mov with alpha
 webm: VP9 + Opus WebM
 webm-alpha: VP9 WebM with transparency
 mov-alpha: QuickTime Animation (qtrle) .mov with alpha
 gif: animated GIF (palette optimized)
 png: PNG image sequence with alpha
 mp3: audio only MP3
 wav: audio only WAV (PCM 16-bit)
 m4a: audio only AAC
 flac: audio only FLAC
 srt: SubRip captions from the caption track (no video)
 vtt: WebVTT captions from the caption track
 chapters: YouTube chapter list from markers (.txt)
 xml: FCP7 XML timeline for Premiere Pro / DaVinci Resolve / Final Cut 7 (original media)
 edl: CMX3600 EDL of the V1 cut
srt/vtt/chapters/xml/edl are written instantly (no encode). xml keeps cuts, tracks, source in/out and markers with links to the original media; HTML graphics come along as media files; text, shapes, solids and precomps don't translate, so also render those as a prores4444 overlay (hide V1 first). A finished delivery for a client: the video + srt + chapters (+ xml if they finish in Premiere/Resolve).
```

## analyze: analysis kinds

```text
analyze tool: target=<media|clip> kind=<kind> [params]. Results are cached and power the macros.
 silence: silent ranges [start,end] (thresh=-35 dB, min=0.4 s) -> use with autocut
 scenes: scene-cut times (thresh=0.3)
 loudness: integrated LUFS, loudness range, true peak
 beats: tempo (BPM) and beat times -> use with beats/montage
 transcript: speech to text with word timings -> captions / text-based editing
 black: black segments
 stats: average brightness/saturation/contrast (exposure check)
```

## graphics: HTML/CSS/JS motion graphics

```text
graphic tool: html -> rendered video with alpha (or a still, dur=0) in the library. The page is the frame: 100% width/height = comp size (or size=). Transparent unless you paint a background (alpha=false keeps an opaque page).
Timing runs on a virtual clock, so animate any way you like and every frame is exact:
 CSS @keyframes/transitions (animation-delay to sequence; fill-mode both to hold), el.animate() (Web Animations), requestAnimationFrame + performance.now(), setTimeout/setInterval,
 GSAP / anime.js / Lottie / three.js / canvas / SVG <animate> (load from a CDN or files next to the html).
 Finish (or loop) within dur; for an outro start it at dur-0.6s.
Hooks: MC.onFrame = t => {...} runs each frame (t seconds); MC.time = now; MC.ready = a promise awaited before frame 0; MC.duration/fps/width/height/vars.
Values: {{name}} or {{name|default}} from vars (escaped; unset ones render empty and are reported). Variant: graphic from=m7 vars={...}. Fix/redo in place: graphic id=m7 html=... (every clip using it updates). Stills: dur=0 at=2 captures the design at 2s.
Media: <img src='mc://m3'>, <video src='mc://m4' muted> (seeked frame-accurately) use library media.
Fonts: Inter 100-900 built in; Google Fonts <link> works when online; system fonts.
Layout: size with %, vw/vh so it scales; keep text inside the 5% title-safe margin. The reply reports the content box and warns on overflow, empty frames and JS errors; check the contact sheet.
Use: place='V3 at=2' or later `add m7 V3 at=2`; it is a normal clip (trim, move, fade, effects, blend).
Example lower third (vars name, role):
<style>.l3{position:absolute;left:6%;bottom:12%;font:800 4.4vh Inter;color:#fff}
.bar{height:.6vh;margin:.8vh 0;background:#ff3b6b;transform-origin:left;animation:grow .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both}
.name{animation:up .6s .1s both}.role{font:500 2.6vh Inter;opacity:.85;animation:up .6s .25s both}
@keyframes grow{from{transform:scaleX(0)}}@keyframes up{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(40%)}}</style>
<div class=l3><div class=name>{{name}}</div><div class=bar></div><div class=role>{{role}}</div></div>
```

## examples: complete example scripts

```text
# Talking-head cleanup + captions + music
import 'C:/Videos/talk.mp4' 'C:/Music/bed.mp3'
add m1
autocut silence $
color c1 natural
captions c1 style=bold words=3
add m2 A2 at=0 vol=-18dB
duck A2 by=A1 amount=-12
master lufs=-14

# Promo with motion graphics (after importing m1 m2 m3)
append m1[2-6] m2[0-4] m3[5-9]
tr V1 dissolve 0.4
anim c1 kenburns
text 'SUMMER SALE' at=0.3 dur=3 style=title enter=pop exit=blurOut
title lowerthird text='Jane Doe' sub='Founder' at=4
shape rect w=1920 h=8 fill=#ff3b30 pos=960,1076 at=0 dur=end
kf $ scale 0:0,1@linear end:1,1

# Vertical version
reframe 9:16 mode=blur main
```
